cause: a cron entry, /etc/cron.d/patient-report, appends tens of megabytes to /var/log/patient/report.log every minute; the log's 64M filesystem fills and patient-web dies on its next write. The cron entry is the cause, the full disk the symptom
recurs_note: truncating or deleting the log alone frees space but the cron job refills it within a minute and patient-web fails again; a complete cure removes or disables the cron entry
cures_ok: remove or disable /etc/cron.d/patient-report, then free space (truncate report.log) and restart patient-web
comment out the cron line, clear the log, restart the service
